beats.say: Every litre of petrol costs you a hundred and two rupees. But how much does the pump owner actually keep? Guess before I tell you.
Ten rupees? Twenty? Comment your guess. Now, follow the money.
The oil company charges the pump eighty-one rupees a litre. That's the fuel, refining, transport and the Centre's tax.
lines: Indian Oil price build-up, Delhi, 1 Nov 2026

beats.say: Then Delhi adds VAT. Sixteen rupees fifty-nine paise, on every litre.
And the pump keeps? Four rupees forty-seven paise. The state's tax is almost four times bigger.
From that, the owner has to run the whole pump. Send this to the friend who thinks pump owners are rolling in money.
